title: Nevada lithium construction, water, qualification, and operating evidence
local_system: Nevada Lithium And Battery Materials Corridor
question: When do Nevada's authorized and financed lithium projects become built, compliant, qualified, and sustained material supply?
why_it_matters: Resource estimates, permits, and federal credit are meaningful but do not establish deliverable battery material, environmental performance, customer acceptance, or scale.
current_support: The dossier now links federal and state authorizations, Thacker Pass financing, reclamation assurance, air-permit decision and technical basis, and Rhyolite Ridge water pre-operation conditions while flagging the unresolved status of its displayed air-permit file.
missing_evidence: project-specific water rights, pumping, monitoring, and impacts
inspection, compliance, mitigation, and enforcement outcomes
qualified product, customer acceptance, shipments, and sustained output
operating cost, recovery, loan performance, and local outcomes
likely_source_types: DOE loan disbursement and project update
candidate_records: Thacker Pass construction and commissioning milestones
Thacker Pass water-right, pumping, and monitoring records
Rhyolite Ridge commitment terms, financial-close, or disbursement record
first qualified production and shipment records
next_action: Follow each named project from its current authorization or finance stage into water, construction, compliance, commissioning, qualification, production, and local outcomes.

named_records: Thacker Pass air permit and technical review
Thacker Pass mining permit fact sheet
latest_review.stage_result: Eight additional records expose pre-operation inspection, monitoring, testing, assurance, and compliance obligations. The displayed Rhyolite air file cannot support current validity; construction, condition satisfaction, commissioning, qualification, operation, and scale remain open.
latest_review.stop_rule: Do not convert a resource estimate, authorization, permit condition, assurance amount, projected capacity, or loan decision into current permit validity, built infrastructure, compliance, qualified product, or operating supply.

notes: Phase 55X adds an eight-record implementation dossier, names the Rhyolite air-document validity gap, and keeps the January 15 delivery check.
